findings.evidence: The full caption runs across the top. Percent of population is printed beside the vertical axis.
findings.assessment: The output promotes the axis label to title. The human reference supports the caption interpretation.
findings.attention_reason: The layout distinguishes the caption and axis label. The council can consider a policy amendment without a reference decision.

findings.evidence: Coef and SE are adjacent column headings under One lag and Two lags. Monsoon Onset is a row label.
findings.assessment: SE describes the statistic for a concept in the row. The output treats it as a separate variable.
findings.attention_reason: The column and row headings establish the statistical role of SE. The finding can inform a policy amendment without adjudication.

findings.evidence: The D2 data snapshot has stars and a footer directing the reader to the notes to table 1.
findings.assessment: The extraction preserves the same visible cross-reference as the gold annotation. The image does not establish what the thresholds are.
findings.uncertainty: The image leaves the meaning of the significance markers open. The notes to table 1 would be needed to establish the thresholds.
findings.attention_reason: Assigning thresholds would affect interpretation of the estimates. Ask the reviewer whether the visible cross-reference suffices for the metadata.

review_scope: title, median age unit and year categories

findings.evidence: The bars have numerical labels and the vertical scale has no unit title. The legend shows HIGH and LOW_MIDDLE.
findings.assessment: The image does not identify countries as the counted entity or print countries as a unit.
findings.uncertainty: The counted entity remains unspecified in the data snapshot.
findings.attention_reason: P001 allows unsupported values to remain unset. The council can consider this grounding issue without a reference or schema decision.
